# Sidebar

The side navigation of an app, open while people work.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Brand expressive</span> Sidebar is for apps people move around all session. Brand expressive avoids tools people use for hours, and a visit lasts a few minutes at most. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./navigation-menu">Navigation menu</a>, <a href="./drawer">Drawer</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Apps with several sections people move between all session.
- **Not when:** A website's main navigation (navigation menu), or a few sections that fit in tabs.

Instead:

- [Navigation menu](./navigation-menu.md): Website navigation.
- [Tabs](./tabs.md): Views of one thing.

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It is a navigation landmark; the current section is marked; collapsing keeps names for icons. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add sidebar
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Sidebar reads 82 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Sidebar's tokens to change Sidebar alone.
